events.address: Century 21 NYC, 22 Cortlandt St, New York, NY 10007
events.what_it_is: A two-day public Fashion Week runway activation on Century 21's main floor. Visitors can walk the runway and be filmed for the store's social stories.
events.what_is_free: Each walker receives a Century 21 tote, up to five iron-on patches pressed onto it, and a $21-off-$100 in-store card, while supplies last.
events.caveats: Century 21's official page says no ticket, invitation or online sign-up is required. Totes and patches are while supplies last. Walking the runway entails being filmed for Century 21 social stories; visitors may watch/shop instead if they do not want to be filmed.
events.practical_notes: September 15 and September 16, 12–6 PM each day. Enter on the Dey Street side of the main floor and join the line.

events.address: Union Square Plaza, Broadway between E 17th and E 18th St, New York, NY 10003
events.what_it_is: A two-day mobile scalp-care pop-up showcasing Dr. Groot's Korean hair and scalp-care products, fragrances and scalp-first product science through interactive experiences.
events.what_is_free: Public access to the mobile Scalp Lab experience; current listings do not establish a guaranteed take-home giveaway, so no free product is promised here.
events.caveats: Average Socialite and NYC for FREE both list the Union Square activation as open to the public. LG H&H has separately announced upcoming Dr. Groot pop-ups in New York, but a direct official event page with these exact hours was not located in this pass.
events.practical_notes: Wednesday, September 16: 11 AM–7 PM. Thursday, September 17: 11 AM–5 PM. Union Square Plaza on Broadway between E 17th and E 18th Streets.

events.address: CityPickle Times Square, New York, NY
events.what_it_is: A Perk pickleball afternoon at CityPickle Times Square with games, giveaways, food and drinks; attendees can come with a team, a friend or solo.
events.what_is_free: The organizer advertises free RSVP plus games, giveaways, food and drinks.
events.caveats: Perk's current social/company posts advertise a free sign-up and note that only a handful of places remained available in the days before the event. Registration capacity may therefore close as the event approaches.
events.practical_notes: Wednesday, September 16, 11:30 AM–2 PM at CityPickle Times Square. Use Perk's organizer sign-up link.

events.address: Printemps New York, One Wall Street, New York, NY 10005
events.what_it_is: An official Printemps New York pop-up displaying 15 special LANCEL Premier Flirt editions created for the French house's 150th anniversary.
events.what_is_free: Free public browsing of the capsule display; merchandise is sold separately.
events.caveats: This is a retail display/pop-up, not a giveaway event. Printemps' official event page lists the capsule September 16 through October 18, 10 AM–8 PM, in the Playroom.
events.practical_notes: Open daily September 16–October 18, 10 AM–8 PM in the Playroom at Printemps New York, One Wall Street.
